text: ふふ　また　たたかうのね　…　カモ　だわ！

structure.jp: また　たたかうのね

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end (a soft form of のだ, often used by women) shows the speaker has just understood the situation. たたかうのね = 'so we're battling, are we'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to add feeling to a statement. カモ　だわ = 'you're an easy mark!'.
